The PR moves Feishu app-registration’s 10-second request deadline into `fetchWithSsrFGuard`, removes redundant request-level abort timers, and adds a hung-header regression test.

target.title: fix(feishu): pass timeoutMs through app-registration guarded fetch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Feishu app-registration HTTP went through `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without a top-level `timeoutMs`. Sibling Feishu surfaces (`streaming-card`) already pass `timeoutMs` so undici dispatcher + guarded abort both fire. Registration previously relied only on `AbortSignal.timeout` inside `RequestInit`, which does not configure the guarded-fetch dispatcher hang floor the same way.

A Feishu/Lark accounts peer that accepts TCP but never returns headers could stall onboarding / QR registration longer than intended, especially if `init.signal` is dropped on a future refactor.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wire `timeoutMs` into `fetchFeishuJson` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard`, matching the streaming-card pattern:

- Default floor: existing `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` (10s) — keeps the tighter wizard budget (not the 30s `FEISHU_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS` API client default)
- Optional `timeoutMs` on registration fetch options for tests / overrides
- Remove redundant `init.signal` timeouts now owned by the guarded fetch

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** Registration HTTP depended on `RequestInit.signal` alone; guarded-fetch `timeoutMs` / dispatcher hang floor was unset.

**After:** Every registration JSON call installs a 10s guarded `timeoutMs`. Hung accounts endpoints reject with `TimeoutError: request timed out`.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.ts`
- Production caller under test: `beginAppRegistration` → `postRegistration` → `fetchFeishuJson` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard` against a local hung HTTP server (SSRF-redirected accounts host)
- Regression: `extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts`

### Caller-path hang proof (Vitest)

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text

 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > prints scan-to-create QR codes with compact terminal rendering 0ms
[feishu fetchFeishuJson hang proof] timed_out=true name=TimeoutError
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > times out registration POSTs when accounts never return headers 85ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > rejects Feishu API responses that exceed the 16 MiB JSON body cap 29ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > parses under-cap Feishu API JSON responses and returns the typed payload 5ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > sends bound reads through the real SSRF guard before local socket redirect 9ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > Feishu app registration > wraps malformed Feishu API JSON with a feishu.api labelled error 3ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > feishu bound reads — local HTTP server > rejects oversized response before fully buffering the response (OOM guard) 22ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts > feishu bound reads — local HTTP server > parses well-formed JSON response under the cap 2ms

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 8.12s
```

## Real behavior proof

**Commands run:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**Before fix:**
`fetchFeishuJson` called `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without `timeoutMs`.

**After fix:**
`beginAppRegistration` against a server that never writes headers rejects with `TimeoutError: request timed out` when `timeoutMs: 80` (stand-in for production `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`).

**Evidence after fix:**

**What was not tested:**
Live Feishu/Lark accounts endpoints; full 10s production floor duration.
